name: OneWeb (Eutelsat) LTEF Data Source
description: Executable data-source: pulls OneWeb's public LTEF (long-term ephemeris file) over HTTP on a timer, emits schema-exact SDS OEM records per satellite, and signs + publishes a PNM pointer.

timers.description: Periodic OneWeb LTEF pull (default every 6h; the whole-fleet LTEF regenerates ~daily — one small CSV, per-pull record churn bounded by objectCap).

methods.description: Fetches OneWeb's public LTEF over HTTP, emits schema-exact SDS OEM records per satellite, signs a PNM, and publishes it.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointers published for each pulled + stored OneWeb ephemeris record.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published pull record.
